CustomField.description: Read-only formula that is TRUE when at least one of the 15 Form Component Section lookups is populated. It exists because Lightning component-visibility rules cap at 10 filters, so the 15 section lookups are collapsed into this single flag to drive the record page's empty-state visibility (show the 'add a section' prompt when FALSE, the section UI when TRUE). Maintained automatically by the formula engine; no input.
CustomField.formula: NOT( ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section1__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section2__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section3__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section4__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section5__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section6__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section7__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section8__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section9__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section10__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section11__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section12__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section13__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section14__c) && ISBLANK(Form_Component_Section15__c) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This read-only checkbox is automatically TRUE once the page has at least one assigned section component. It is what the record page uses to switch between the empty-state prompt and the section editor, so there is nothing to enter here.
CustomField.label: Has Assigned Sections
